n: Google teaching responsible use of AI lesson plan
t: A discussion lesson that helps students plan responsible use of AI models.
steps: Find the lesson plan on Google for Education.
Download the PDF, the student handouts, and the slides.
Decide whether to use the optional Try it on Gemini exercises.
Check the Gemini access rules at your school before using those exercises.
Plan 90 to 125 minutes, or split the lesson over two sessions.
